blocks.text: Uruguay's capital stretches along the Río de la Plata. The Rambla runs beside the water for kilometres. People come here to run, drink mate or fish from the seawall. In the centre, you'll find historic squares, Palacio Salvo, the Solís Theatre and the Mercado del Puerto, a former port market now home to restaurants, grills and bars.

blocks.text: Today you travel to the enchanting UNESCO town of Colonia del Sacramento. Cobblestone streets, colorful houses and centuries-old architecture create an atmosphere frozen in time. Wander through charming alleys, discover historic Portuguese fortifications and enjoy breathtaking views over the Río de la Plata — a place where history whispers at every corner. Lunch is included.
A cobbled street in Colonia del Sacramento leads between old houses towards the waterfront, Uruguay
